request: Create two cover parts, that have matching outer shape to the outer contour of the central part, sit flush on its outer surface and its counterpart on the other side and have thickness of 0,254cm

actions.operation: Create a new cover part whose outer boundary matches the outer contour of the central part and which is formed to sit flush on the central part's outer surface
actions.target: Central part outer contour / central part outer surface
actions.relational_constraint: Cover part outer shape matches the central part outer contour; cover part sits flush (in contact, no offset) on the referenced outer surface
actions.unresolved_reference: Resolved: the 'central part' is Section S3 (Central clamp block). The 'outer surface' for the first cover is the outer planar face at Y=27.94 (face_code 0023). The 'outer contour' is the outer perimeter edge-loop of that face; internal loops (through-bolt/counterbore and auxiliary holes) should be projected as cutouts to avoid interference and preserve access.
steps: Create new component/body: name it Cover_Upper (new section/new solid, do not modify S1/S2/S3).

Set the sketch plane to the central clamp block outer planar face: S3 face_code 0023 (Top_face, Brep FACE 53). Ensure sketch normal points outward from the clamp (positive Y direction from that face).

In the sketch, Project/Convert Entities of the full outer perimeter edge-loop of face_code 0023 to capture the exact rounded-rectangle outer contour (this is the ‘matching outer shape’ requirement). Do not apply offset to this perimeter; keep it coincident to maintain flush silhouette match.

Also Project/Convert Entities of any inner loops on that same face created by openings that must remain pass-through/accessible: the through-bolt/counterbore opening region associated with S3 face_code 0062/0061, and the two auxiliary fastener openings associated with S3 face_code 0068 and 0069 (axis ~Y). These projected loops become internal cut profiles in the cover.

Finish sketch. Extrude the sketch as a New Body/New Component by distance 2.54 mm (0.254 cm) in the outward normal direction of face_code 0023 so the cover’s inner face remains coincident (flush) with the clamp outer surface at Y=27.94.

If the CAD system requires explicit “flush” constraint: apply a Mate/As-built joint constraint or set the extrusion start condition to “From Face” = face_code 0023 with start offset = 0.00, ensuring zero gap contact.

Optional robustness step (recommended for parametric stability): define the cover sketch using “Use/Project edges of face” references rather than manual dimensions so that if clamp outer contour changes (fillets/steps), the cover updates to match.

actions.operation: Create a second new cover part on the counterpart outer surface on the other side of the central part, matching the same outer contour and sitting flush
actions.target: Counterpart outer surface on the other side of the central part
actions.relational_constraint: Second cover is positioned on the opposite-side counterpart surface; sits flush on that surface; matches the central part outer contour
actions.unresolved_reference: Resolved: the 'counterpart' surface is the opposite outer planar face of the same central clamp block, S3 face_code 0052 (Bottom_face, Y=-15.24). Create an independent cover (or a mirrored/duplicated derived component) and ensure it follows the outer perimeter and any required hole loops on that face (counterbore/through-bolt and auxiliary holes) so it does not clash with bolt hardware/features.
steps: Create new component/body: name it Cover_Lower (new section/new solid, do not modify S1/S2/S3).

Set the sketch plane to the opposite outer planar face of the clamp block: S3 face_code 0052 (Bottom_face, Brep FACE 72). Ensure sketch normal points outward from the clamp (negative Y direction from that face).

Project/Convert Entities of the full outer perimeter edge-loop of face_code 0052 to capture the exact counterpart outer contour (rounded-rectangle silhouette). Keep it non-offset for exact contour matching.

Project/Convert Entities of inner loops/openings on that face that must remain open: the through-bolt/counterbore opening region associated with S3 face_code 0063/0061, plus the auxiliary fastener openings associated with S3 face_code 0068 and 0069, so the cover does not interfere with fasteners and remains assembly-compatible.

Finish sketch. Extrude as New Body/New Component by 2.54 mm (0.254 cm) outward from face_code 0052 (negative Y direction). Set extrusion start condition to “From Face” = face_code 0052 with start offset = 0.00 to guarantee flush contact.

If desired/allowed by design intent: instead of re-sketching, derive Cover_Lower by mirroring Cover_Upper about the appropriate symmetry datum of the clamp in Y (noting clamp extents are asymmetric about Y=0; verify mirror plane location from the clamp design intent—commonly the mid-thickness plane near Y=6.35). If mirrored, revalidate that the mirrored cover sits flush on face_code 0052 with zero offset.

intention: Add two cover components that conform to the central part's exterior and close/cover it from both sides while maintaining a thin, uniform cover thickness.
